mcq.q: Which design choice would minimize delay in a multi-bit addition circuit?

options.A: Using a half adder for every bit.

mcq.q: Which of the following statements about carry look-ahead adders (CLA) is TRUE ?

options.A: CLA generates all carries simultaneously using generate and propagate signals.
options.B: CLA is slower than ripple-carry adders.
options.C: CLA cannot add more than 4 bits.
options.D: CLA requires no additional hardware compared to ripple adders.

mcq.answer_text: CLA generates all carries simultaneously using generate and propagate signals.

mcq.q: How does a carry look-ahead adder (CLA) reduce delay compared to a ripple-carry adder?

options.A: By generating all carries in parallel using Generate (G) and Propagate (P) signals
options.D: By limiting bit addition to 4 bits

mcq.answer_text: By generating all carries in parallel using Generate (G) and Propagate (P) signals

sq.q: If A = 1011 and B = 0110 with Cin = 1, compute the sum and carry using a 4-bit Ripple-Carry Adder.

answer: The main limitation of an RCA is propagation delay due to sequential carry generation from one stage to the next, which makes it slow for large bit-width additions.
